The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Borga Besadii Diori|Borga]] owned a '''palace''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. [[Nom Anor]] and [[Malik Carr]] visited the palace in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] when the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] were negotiating with the Hutts.
